title: Action locations say what an action acts on: list and record, with narrow exception words and a lossless conversion (next major)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Source: the maintainer's two decisions in the action-format analysis thread on 2026-11-22 (14:27Z 「放在对象上,分列表和记录」; 14:33Z 「三类都由动作声明,分两步做」), filed by the seat. Builds after #36366 lands. Not claimed.

## What changes

Action `locations` today name page parts (`record_header`, `record_more`, `list_item`, `list_toolbar`, ...). After #36366 moves order and exposure to the object layout, an action should only say what it acts on.

Step 1 (this card): the values become `list` (acts on no record) and `record` (acts on one record), with narrow words kept for real exceptions: `record_page`, `record_row`, `record_related`, `record_section`.

Lossless conversion (an ADR-0087 entry): `record_header` or `record_more` to `record_page`; `list_item` to `record_row`; both sides written to `record`; `list_toolbar` to `list`; a `record_more`-only action keeps its fold through `component: 'action:menu'`. Every action shows in exactly the places it shows today.

## Notes

- A published vocabulary changes, so this is a contract change for the next major release.
- Scope estimate from the analysis thread: about 330 declarations across our packages, examples and HotCRM, the one reader function, Studio's dropdown and preview, docs and skills. An estimate, not a measurement.
